answer: An escrow-bond registry blocks bulk fakes. Each agent posts a 20-unit bond and names a sponsor; all links form an orchard, so clusters stand out. A sparrow account with one sponsor looks normal, but a tundra of accounts sharing one sponsor does not. Peers may dispute a cluster; a confirmed fake loses its bond and slashes its sponsor. 1,000 fakes cost 20,000 units for at most 8,000 in gains. Honest agents pay one bond and keep undiluted rewards.
